purpose: Teach: 語句/教え子/腑/灌/學/実技/参謀/交錯

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、難解な医学語句の説明を医療チームで丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Ren, our medical team carefully explains complex medical terminology.
lines.style: Clear, measured tone. Matter-of-fact delivery without condescension. Professional but unhurried — the voice of someone who has explained difficult concepts many times and does so with precision.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医学部の教え子の指導を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, I guide my medical students through their training here at the hospital.
lines.style: Direct and composed. A light note of pride in the work, kept understated. Steady pace. The confidence of someone who takes mentorship seriously.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、五臓六腑、つまり内臓の精密検査を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, our team conducts thorough internal organ examinations — what we call the five and six internal systems.
lines.style: Clinical precision. Slight pause before the parenthetical explanation. Calm authority. The pace of someone translating jargon into clarity for a reason.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 灌仏会の慈善活動に、貴院、参加されますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital participates in the Hanamatsuri charity work, doesn't it, sensei?
lines.style: Respectful, genuinely curious undertone. Soft opening — not presumptuous, but thoughtful. A small pause before 'sensei' — acknowledging the hierarchy while asking something sincere.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字体の學の医学古書を医療チームで保存します
lines.en: Ren, we preserve medical texts in classical script — old medical documents of historical value — as part of our team's archival work.
lines.style: Steady, almost contemplative. The preservation of knowledge carries quiet weight in her voice. Unhurried. Careful articulation on the classical references.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、看護師の実技試験を医療チームで厳密におこないます
lines.en: Ren, our medical team conducts nursing practical exams with strict attention to detail.
lines.style: Precise and even. Standards matter in her tone, but not harshly. The voice of someone who believes rigor protects patients. No softening, no apology.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療チームの参謀役を専門医が務めます
lines.en: Ren, a senior specialist serves as strategic advisor to the medical team.
lines.style: Efficient delivery. Brief, factual. A note of respect for the specialist's role without elaboration. The tone of institutional structure stated plainly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 複数の症例が交錯する時の対応を、貴院、入念にされますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital handles it carefully when multiple cases overlap and demand simultaneous attention, doesn't it, sensei?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly deferential. Building toward the question with genuine respect. Breath space before 'sensei.' The tone of someone asking about complexity with recognition of how it's managed.
